title: Observations for the visit
description: Photos, video and short notes add up to a history for the conversation with the vet.

blocks.text: At the appointment it is hard to remember when the episode started and what came before it. A single video with no date is not much help.

quote.text: I was very happy using this to keep track of the frequency of vomiting and hairballs for my two cats.

blocks.text: Record an event quickly with a time, add material later and pick the period for the summary. The owner looks the set over before sending it.
The original observations stay next to the explanations. The specialist’s conclusions should be distinguishable from the owner’s records.
